reason: Response-free source code shows that only 47 of the 274 candidate wetlands carry repeated detection histories. Annual occupied source state is therefore not observed over the full network. The validation target is narrowed before response access to the known-founder conditional forecast supported by the three 2003 reintroduction sites.

latent_layer.source_policy: fixed known 2003 founder ponds throughout reconstruction and multi-horizon propagation
latent_layer.node_universe: all 274 response-free candidate wetlands in coords.dryad.csv
latent_layer.world_update: early positive survey detections may contract the frozen rule universe; they are evidence constraints, not automatically promoted to observed annual sources
latent_layer.historical_claim: none; reachable from declared founders under a frozen rule does not identify the actual colonization path

predictive_target_candidate.name: first survey-recorded detection by declared horizon from the 2003 founders
predictive_target_candidate.evaluation_nodes: the 47 archived repeatedly surveyed sites, whose row alignment is declared in the source code without opening detection values
predictive_target_candidate.positive_semantics: survey-recorded detection by the target horizon
predictive_target_candidate.negative_semantics: no recorded detection by the target horizon among site-years with archived survey effort; not latent biological absence
predictive_target_candidate.missing_semantics: NA or no survey is excluded rather than recoded as negative
predictive_target_candidate.destroyed_sites: the three source-code-declared destroyed sites are unavailable from their declared model-year index and are not ordinary negatives

temporal_design_to_freeze_after_structur.candidate_holdout_policy: freeze a final contiguous block using year metadata only after structural Gate 1 passes
temporal_design_to_freeze_after_structur.horizon_interpretation: discrete propagation depth from the known founders; physical annual interpretation requires the later frozen transition calibration

two_layer_prediction.layer_a: exact frozen rule identity for compatibility, contraction and falsification

forbidden: using latent occupancy estimates at the 227 unsurveyed wetlands as observed source state
restricting the candidate network to ever-detected wetlands
using later detection values to choose structural thresholds or founders
